coder_notes: Record states the study was withdrawn before enrollment. CYNK-001 is an allogeneic NK cell therapy (excluded type). rhIL-2 is given subcutaneously before each CYNK-001 dose in all arms; not a separately registered intervention but part of every patient's treatment and named in the title; coded as candidate by analogy with the checkpoint inhibitor + vaccine worked example, flagged uncertain because it may only be supporting NK cells. Cyclophosphamide and fludarabine (lymphodepletion) coded supportive per R6. Mesna is mentioned only in an exclusion criterion, not listed. Conditions include 'Glioblastoma Multiforme' and 'Astrocytoma, Grade IV' but eligibility requires IDH1 wild-type, so cns5.
